title: Pure Pendulum Magician
summary: Yuya Sakaki's Pendulum Magician archetype is a Scale 1 and Scale 8 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum combo-and-control deck centered around Harmonizing Magician, Double Iris Magician, Black Fang Magician, Purple Poison Magician, and Wisdom-Eye Magician! Use Wisdom-Eye Magician, Skullcrobat Joker, or Pendulum Call to set up your Scales and search Star Pendulumgraph + Time Pendulumgraph. When you Pendulum Summon Harmonizing Magician from your hand, it Special Summons any Magician Pendulum from your Deck (enabling Rank 4 Timestar Magician or Level 8 Supreme King Dragon Clear Wing). Whenever Double Iris, Black Fang, or Purple Poison are destroyed on your turn or by Time Pendulumgraph on the opponent's turn, they trigger floating effects in the GY/Extra Deck while Time Pendulumgraph sends a 2nd card your opponent controls to the GY without targeting or destroying!

allow.Performapal Skullcrobat Joker: Yuya's Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum starter that searches ANY 'Magician' Pendulum Monster from your Deck upon Normal Summon.
allow.Performapal Celestial Magician: Scale 8 Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that activates bonus effects based on monster card types you control and recovers a Pendulum from GY in the End Phase.
allow.Astrograph Sorcerer: Limited to 1 in TCG: Scale 1 Level 7 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that Special Summons itself from your hand whenever a card you control is destroyed and adds a copy of a destroyed monster from your Deck to your hand!
allow.Supreme King Gate Magician: Scale 1 Level 7 LIGHT Spellcaster Pendulum that places a Scale or sends a Dragon from Extra Deck to GY to Special Summon itself from hand.
allow.Ignister Prominence, the Blasting Dracos: Level 8 Synchro summoned using Level 4 Tuner Harmonizing Magician + any Level 4 Magician Pendulum that destroys Double Iris or Purple Poison to shuffle an opponent's card into the Deck without targeting!
allow.Supreme King Dragon Clear Wing: Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro that destroys all face-up monsters your opponent controls on Synchro Summon!
allow.Supreme King Dragon Dark Rebellion: Rank 4 DARK Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 DARK Pendulum Monsters) that reduces an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and gains that original ATK.
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that searches any Magician Scale before you Pendulum Summon and pops 2 cards on the field.
allow.Exceed the Pendulum: Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster Pendulum that adds a face-up Magician from your Extra Deck to your hand and Special Summons a Magician from your hand or GY during the Main Phase.
allow.Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians: Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster that revives a Magician from your GY.
allow.Enlightenment Paladin: Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Synchro that recovers a Spell Card from your GY when Synchro Summoned using a Magician Pendulum Monster.

main: Harmonizing Magician

Core Scale 8 Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum Tuner: cannot be Special Summoned from Extra Deck; when Pendulum Summoned from hand, Special Summons ANY 'Magician' Pendulum Monster from your Deck in Defense Position!
Double Iris Magician

Core Scale 8 Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum: doubles battle damage in the Pendulum Zone and destroys itself; if destroyed by battle or card effect, adds 1 'Pendulumgraph' card from your Deck to your hand!
Purple Poison Magician

Core Scale 1 Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum: boosts your battling DARK Spellcaster by 1200 ATK in the Pendulum Zone and destroys itself; whenever this card is destroyed, targets 1 face-up card on the field and destroys it!
Black Fang Magician
Scale 8 Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum: halves an opponent's monster's ATK in the Pendulum Zone and destroys itself; if destroyed, targets 1 DARK Spellcaster in your GY and Special Summons it!
Wisdom-Eye Magician

Core Scale 5 Level 4 LIGHT Spellcaster Pendulum: if you have a 'Magician' or 'Performapal' card in your other Pendulum Zone, destroys itself in the Pendulum Zone and places ANY 'Magician' Pendulum Monster from your Deck into your Pendulum Zone!
Oafdragon Magician

Scale 2 Level 6 WIND Spellcaster Pendulum: in the Pendulum Zone, adds 1 face-up 'Magician' or 'Odd-Eyes' Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck to your hand; on Summon, adds 1 Magician Pendulum or Odd-Eyes from your GY to your hand.
White Wing Magician
Scale 1 Level 4 WIND Spellcaster Pendulum Tuner that negates effects targeting your DARK Spellcasters in the Pendulum Zone.
Performapal Celestial Magician
Scale 8 Level 4 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that recovers a Pendulum from your GY during the End Phase.
Supreme King Gate Magician
Scale 1 Level 7 LIGHT Spellcaster Pendulum that Special Summons itself from hand and searches Pendulum Evolution/fusion spells.
Performapal Skullcrobat Joker
Normal Summon starter: adds any 'Magician' Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your hand when Normal Summoned.
Astrograph Sorcerer
Limited to 1 in TCG: when a card you control is destroyed, Special Summons itself from your hand and adds a copy of a monster destroyed this turn from your Deck to your hand!
Pendulum Call
Core Spell: discards 1 card to add 2 'Magician' Pendulum Monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand, and protects 'Magician' cards in your Pendulum Zones from destruction!
Duelist Alliance
Adds Pendulum Call, Double Iris Magician, Star Pendulumgraph, or Time Pendulumgraph from your Deck to your hand while a card is in a Pendulum Zone.
Star Pendulumgraph

Signature Continuous Spell: protects Spellcasters from Spell targeting; once per turn, if a face-up 'Magician' Pendulum leaves your Monster or Pendulum Zone, adds 1 'Magician' Pendulum Monster from Deck to hand!
Time Pendulumgraph

Signature Continuous Trap: protects Spellcasters from Trap targeting; targets 1 'Magician' Pendulum Monster Card and 1 card your opponent controls and destroys them, and sends a card to GY without targeting if 2 cards were not destroyed!
extra: Signature Rank 4 DARK Spellcaster Xyz boss (2 Level 4 'Magician' Pendulum Monsters): detaches 1 material to add ANY DARK Spellcaster monster from your Deck, GY, or face-up Extra Deck to your hand; protects Pendulum Cards by sending a Spellcaster from Deck to GY instead!
Signature Level 8 DARK Spellcaster Synchro: recovers a Spell Card (Pendulum Call or Duelist Alliance!) from your GY when Synchro Summoned using a 'Magician' Pendulum Monster!
Level 8 DARK Dragon Synchro (Harmonizing Magician + any Level 4 DARK Magician!) that destroys ALL face-up monsters your opponent controls on Synchro Summon!
Level 8 Dragon Synchro that destroys Double Iris or Purple Poison to shuffle an opponent's card into the Deck without targeting.
Rank 4 DARK Dragon Xyz that drops an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and gains that ATK for an instant OTK.
Link-2 DARK Spellcaster Pendulum that searches Harmonizing Magician or Astrograph Sorcerer before you Pendulum Summon and pops 2 cards on the field.
Link-3 LIGHT Spellcaster Pendulum that recovers a face-up Magician from your Extra Deck and Special Summons a Magician during the Main Phase.
Selene, Queen of the Master Magicians
Link-3 Spellcaster that revives a Magician from your GY.
